_doc: Cross-language search-payload parity oracle. Every adapter (openclaw, hermes, nanobot, moltis, ironclaw, zeroclaw via klodi-rust-host) MUST emit the same on-wire NATS request payload for klodi_search (subject p2p.v1.listings.search) and klodi_searches_create (subject p2p.v1.searches.create) given the same catalog-shaped input. Each entry pairs an `input` (the params the catalog accepts) with `expected_wire_payload` (the JSON body that should arrive at the subject). The pre-merge architectural call (Risks → cross-stack payload-transform drift): expected_wire_payload is the RAW catalog-shaped input — the tool layer's job is to forward unchanged. openclaw's `compactPayload` (adapters/openclaw/src/tools/discovery.ts:60) drops `null` / `undefined` / empty-string values today; that is the divergence this fixture exists to flag (every Search input case here that exercises that divergence guarantees RED on openclaw). The strip-fields `persist` / `action_on_match` / `target_price` remain inside `klodi_watch` (the composite tool) because they are adapter-internal flags, not catalog params; this fixture exercises `klodi_search` / `klodi_searches_create` directly, so those flags never appear in any input. Adding/removing an entry MUST happen via ADR amendment — every adapter's test suite reads this file and asserts coverage. See ADR-0011 for the precedent (envelope-golden.json) and the discovery handoff for the SC-parity.{1,2} acceptance criteria.

search._doc: klodi_search inputs. The full param surface is `query` / `category` / `min_price` / `max_price` / `delivery` / `condition` / `limit` / `cursor` — all optional per the catalog at packages/tool-catalog/src/index.ts:360-369. The matrix covers each shape the agent's payload can take: empty-string params, null params, omitted params, and present-with-typical-values per param. The first three cases are the openclaw divergence cases — they reach the wire as `{}` after `compactPayload` today and as `{query: ''}` / `{category: null}` / `{}` (omitted absent) on every other stack.

search_empty_query_string._when: agent supplies an empty-string query — a deliberate 'show me everything' on a typed surface where the catalog allows the string type

search_null_category._when: agent supplies category=null — semantically 'no category filter'. openclaw's compactPayload drops it; every other stack forwards the null, which the marketplace's matcher reads as 'unfiltered'

search_undefined_via_omission._when: agent omits a param entirely — should be IDENTICAL to passing undefined. The wire payload simply does not carry the key

search_empty_string_and_null_mix._when: every divergence case in one payload — empty-string query + null category + omitted everything else. openclaw forwards `{}`; every other stack forwards `{query: '', category: null}`. This is the smoking-gun input the architect's discovery names as the central failure case

search_pickup_with_radius._when: delivery filter — pickup variant with explicit radiusKm. Discriminated-union variant; the catalog rejects fields foreign to the variant via additionalProperties:false

search_ship_with_to._when: delivery filter — ship variant with destination subdivision (US-NY)

search_digital_variant._when: delivery filter — digital variant carries no extra fields (per catalog discriminated union)

search_any_variant._when: delivery filter — explicit any variant (buyer opts in to flexibility, not nullable)

search_with_cursor._when: agent supplies a pagination cursor for the next page of results

search_with_limit._when: agent sets an explicit result cap

search_minimal_empty_object._when: agent supplies no params at all — the catalog allows it (all params optional). Empty-object input → empty-object payload. All stacks agree here; this is the trivial baseline

search_fully_populated._when: every catalog param present with typical agent values. The wire payload mirrors the input one-for-one (the tool is a thin pass-through)

searches_create._doc: klodi_searches_create inputs. The catalog requires `slug`; `query` / `category` / `min_price` / `max_price` / `delivery` are optional (packages/tool-catalog/src/index.ts:386-395). The standing-search criteria payload mirrors `klodi_search`'s param shape so the marketplace's matcher can evaluate it with the same code path on every new listing. PO SC7.4 closure: tier (1) here proves the REGISTRATION payload reaches the service intact; tier (2) covers end-to-end matcher equivalence. The `klodi_watch` composite in openclaw / Rust does construct the searches.create payload differently from a direct `klodi_searches_create` invocation (it generates the slug, defaults delivery to {method:'any'}); this fixture exercises the catalog tool DIRECTLY, not the composite — agents calling `klodi_searches_create` always supply `slug` themselves.

searches_create_minimal_slug_only._when: agent registers a placeholder standing search with no filtering criteria — the marketplace records it but never matches a listing

searches_create_with_empty_query._when: agent supplies an empty-string query alongside the slug — semantically a 'no-keyword' filter. openclaw drops `query: ''` today; every other stack records it. The marketplace's matcher reads empty-string as 'no keyword constraint' (per skill/SKILL.md §6) — but a stack that drops it sends a fundamentally different criteria payload from a stack that forwards it

searches_create_with_null_category._when: agent supplies category=null with the slug. Mirrors the `klodi_search` divergence on the registration path

searches_create_with_full_criteria._when: agent registers a standing search with the full filter set. The marketplace's `criteria` reply object pins the values back to the agent — tier (2) e2e asserts the round-tripped criteria match what was sent. This entry is the canonical 'fully-populated' criteria recording case (architect handoff: `klodi_searches_create criteria recording`)

searches_create_pickup_delivery._when: agent registers a standing search filtered by pickup delivery with a radius. Discriminated-union variant

searches_create_any_delivery_explicit._when: agent explicitly sets delivery={method:'any'}. Per the catalog this is opt-in flexibility (not nullable). Every stack should forward verbatim
